SOURCE EXTRACTS — read from the full djvu texts, 2026-09-06
============================================================
C. B. POWTER AND D. J. EVANS IN MONTREAL, 1908 AND 1912 — two unrestricted items found by the
p_430 name sweep, both downloaded whole and read.

WHY THESE MEN. C. B. Powter is one of the four named in charge of the YMCA of Montreal's senior
camp at Lake St. Joseph in 1898 (f_4911), four years before he founded his own camp on the same
lake. D. J. Evans is one of the three in charge of Kamp Kanawana in 1913 (directors-index.md, from
the association's 1914 annual report). Neither had any documented life outside the camp records.


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
ITEM 1. COMMERCIAL AND TECHNICAL HIGH SCHOOL (Montreal), PROSPECTUS FOR SESSION 1908-1909
        [Montreal: Eaton, Printer, 1908]
        Internet Archive: prospectusforses00mont (and cihm_74471, the CIHM microform of the same)
        NOT lending-restricted. Full djvu text (29,156 bytes) downloaded and searched.
        "Kanawana" and "camp" occur ZERO times in it.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The staff list, as printed (the leader dots are the prospectus's own):

    " M. A. KEE, ------- Drawing and English
    " K. G. PATTERSON, _____ Reading and French
    " A. COX, _-____--_ Writing
    "- E. M. WILLIAMS, - English and Music
    " M. BROWN, ______ Mathematics and Music
    " L. M. KER, --------- English
    " S. FRANCIS, -__-__ Drawing and French
    " H. M. CUNNINGHAM, - - - - Book-keeping and English
    " C. MACMARTIN, _"-_-_ Arithmetic and English
    MRS. M. L. SIMISTER, -------- Drawing
    W. H. SMITH, ESQ., F.T.S.C. ----- Music
    C. JOHANSSON, ESQ., ------ Manual Training
    C. B. POWTER, ESQ., - - - - - - - Physical Training
    MISS J. DOW, ---_-_--- Domestic Science
    " I. WADE, --_-_-__- Calisthenics
    " S. TYNDALE, ________ Typewriting

So C. B. Powter was **Physical Training master at the Commercial and Technical High School,
Montreal**, in the session 1908-09 — six years after he founded Camp Sans Egal / Powter's Camp on
Lac St. Joseph, and ten after he ran the YMCA's own camp on the same lake.


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
ITEM 2. EXPOSITION POUR LE BIEN-ÊTRE DES ENFANTS, tenue au Manège Militaire, rue Craig,
        Montréal, octobre 1912 : GUIDE-SOUVENIR
        Internet Archive: cihm_81839. NOT lending-restricted; full text (138,982 bytes)
        downloaded and searched. "Kanawana" occurs zero times.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(a) The committee, printed under its own heading:

    "PROGRAMME DES AMUSEMENTS.
    Dr F. Tees, D. J. EVANS, J. McClements, Henry Scott, Mde R. MacMillan, W. H. Smith,
    Mlle Idola St-Jean, C. B. POWTER, Mlle Cartwright, M. J. Chabelle, Major J. Long,
    L. J. MacMahon, J. E. Merritt, Rufus Smith."

(b) The programme itself, Wednesday 9 October 1912:

    "4 P.M. Milice et chœur, par les écoles anglaises, sous la direction de C. B. Powter et
    W. H. Smith."

    (The OCR prints "C, E. Powter" there and "C, B. Powter" in the committee list; the initial
    is B in the school prospectus and in every camp record.)

TWO THINGS FOLLOW.

**Powter and D. J. Evans sat on the same committee.** Evans led Kanawana's 1913 season; Powter had
run the YMCA's camp in 1898 and by 1912 had his own on the same lake. The exhibition is Montreal's
first child-welfare exhibition, held in the Craig Street drill hall in October 1912, and its
amusements committee put both men in the same room a year before Evans took the camp.

**Powter and W. H. Smith are colleagues.** Smith is the Music master on the same school staff list
in Item 1, and the two of them jointly direct the English schools' contribution — drill and chorus
— to the exhibition. This is one school's physical-training and music masters running the English
Protestant schools' public showpiece.

WHAT IT ADDS TO THE CAMP'S OWN STORY. The pattern already visible in F. H. Spinney — Kanawana's
Educational Director, and Principal of Alexandra School, Montreal (f_4958) — holds here too. **The
men the Montreal YMCA put in charge of its camps were schoolmasters**, and specifically the
physical-training and educational specialists of the city's schools. That is not a surprising
finding, but this project had asserted it nowhere and had the evidence for it nowhere either.

NOT ESTABLISHED: Powter's and Evans's first names; whether either taught at the school in any other
year; whether they knew each other before 1912 or through the camps; and what the "Programme des
Amusements" committee actually did. The exhibition's guide-souvenir has not been read beyond the
two passages above and its committee lists.

QUERIES: the name sweep query was `"C. B. Powter"` (19 hits, most of them a modern Alberta
land-reclamation editor of the same initials). Everything else here came from downloading the two
unrestricted items whole and grepping them.
